exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "What kind of Noun".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! どういう Noun matches "What kind of Noun".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is どういう Noun.
exercises.explanation: Used to ask "what kind of" or "what sort of" before a noun for clarification.
